saw_lines: Clean soy candles and room sprays, with 5% of profit going to non profits fighting human trafficking.
<q>Clean Home Fragrance to bring hope.</q> 1,495 reviews and $895,835 donated so far.
11 Meta ads are live right now, and the site links five social channels from Pinterest to YouTube.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active US ads, 9 Oct 2026
points: Mission in every ad, scent in few
All 11 ads lead with the trafficking mission. 4 describe how a candle smells, none mention burn time.
5 ads ask “Wondering if it’s worth it? What’s stopping you?” and never answer with the price, the 90 day swap guarantee or the 1,495 reviews.
15% off the first order and free shipping over $100 are on the site. 0 ads use them.
Static shots for a product sold on mood
1 of 11 ads is a video. Lit candles in real rooms and customer clips show what a jar on white can’t.
